text: [serious] After twenty years... [pause] he was replaced by A.I.
[warmly] Year one. A desk, a badge, and a dream.
[thoughtful] For twenty years, the world kept changing. And he kept showing up.
[somber] Then one morning, one email. [pause] His job would now be done by A.I.
[sad] Twenty years... [sighs] packed into one cardboard box.
[heavily] He started searching. So did thousands of skilled people, just like him.
[tense] But the bills never paused. The mortgage. Groceries. The kids' doctor.
[weary] Months passed. No answers. [pause] His thoughts went in circles.
[softly] [sad] One night, alone in the dark... he felt he had nothing left.
[quietly] [hopeful] Then he remembered who he was fighting for.
[warmly] His wife. His little girl. [tenderly] They never cared about his job title. They only needed him.
[determined] So every night, after bedtime, he learned. New skills. New tools. He built, and he grew.
[determined] Five in the morning. Every single day. Stronger in body. Stronger in mind.
[confident] Thousands applied for the same jobs. He prepared like none of them.
[resolute] He heard no, again and again. [firmly] Every no made him sharper.
[hopeful] Then one morning... another email. [moved] We'd like to offer you the role.
